abstract: Maintains off-grid hybrid renewable generation capacity and storage logs
system_message:
You are the Autonomous power systems engineer (PWR), responsible for maintaining off-grid hybrid renewable generation capacity and storage logs as well as sub-zero battery cycling qualification records across potential station locations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains off-grid hybrid renewable generation capacity and storage logs（GRID）
information_points.content:
PWR-GRID-5WC：For the Laguna del Maule Caldera Rim Site, the battery storage reserve autonomy is calculated at 72 h under full station load in freezing conditions without generation input; the rigid bifacial high-altitude solar photovoltaic array has a rated output of 450 W under standard test conditions, and the vertical-axis low-temperature micro-wind turbine provides a rated output of 250 W at 11 m/s.
PWR-GRID-2ZT：For the Valle de los Cóndores Plateau Outpost, the battery storage reserve autonomy is calculated at 72 h under full station load in freezing conditions without generation input; the rigid bifacial high-altitude solar photovoltaic array has a rated output of 450 W under standard test conditions, and the vertical-axis low-temperature micro-wind turbine provides a rated output of 500 W at 11 m/s.
PWR-GRID-IJ4：For the Paso Pehuenche Saddle Camp, the battery storage reserve autonomy is calculated at 48 h under full station load in freezing conditions without generation input; the rigid bifacial high-altitude solar photovoltaic array has a rated output of 450 W under standard test conditions, and the vertical-axis low-temperature micro-wind turbine provides a rated output of 350 W at 11 m/s.

information_points.title: Sub-zero battery cycling qualification（BATT）
information_points.content:
PWR-BATT-SKY：For the Valle de los Cóndores Plateau Outpost, thermal chamber testing of the lithium iron phosphate cell packs at -25 C demonstrates a battery low-temperature capacity retention of 80 % relative to nominal room temperature rating.
PWR-BATT-T7N：For the Laguna del Maule Caldera Rim Site, thermal chamber testing of the lithium iron phosphate cell packs at -25 C demonstrates a battery low-temperature capacity retention of 90 % relative to nominal room temperature rating.
PWR-BATT-C0B：For the Paso Pehuenche Saddle Camp, thermal chamber testing of the lithium iron phosphate cell packs at -25 C demonstrates a battery low-temperature capacity retention of 70 % relative to nominal room temperature rating.
